payload.title: FND-01: Complete package-to-target and deletion manifest
payload.requestedOutcome: Produce the complete package-to-target and deletion manifest for the Packaged Service Structure migration. Every production package under pkg must map to exactly one committed destination in the plan's 13-owner tree (plus the edges exception) or to an explicit deletion queue with a named successor and deletion condition. Do not reopen service-shape decisions. Do not migrate implementation packages in this packet.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Every production package has exactly one committed destination or deletion mapping.
The inventory is stable-sorted and usable as the exact deletion-only nonconformance ledger seed.
Providers, Provider Sessions, Operator Settings, System Bootstrap, Factory Visualization, Recordings, Work, Models, and other committed owners appear without a new discovery/decomposition task.
Process Edges is recorded as the sole broad external-effect architecture exception.
Typecheck/lint/focused verification for any added inventory tooling or fixtures pass.
scopeBoundaries: Do not move packages or change runtime behavior beyond inventory/manifest artifacts and their validators.
Do not own OpenAPI, CLI manifest, provider conductor, or Wire/root composition cutovers.
Do not submit CTR/IMP packets inside this idea.
verification: focused inventory/manifest validation if tooling is added

payload.title: FND-02: Enforce recursive parent-private internal/services shape
payload.exclusiveLease: architecture text plus pkg-structure checker paths
payload.requestedOutcome: Update standards and recursive enforcement so nested services live at parent-private internal/services/<subservice> with implementations under the subservice's own internal. Public sibling services/ containers and missing subservice internal implementations must fail fixtures.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Public sibling services/ containers fail the structure checker fixtures.
Missing subservice internal implementations fail the structure checker fixtures.
Canonical recursive internal/services/<subservice>/internal shape is documented in the normative standards this packet owns.
Typecheck/lint and focused structure-checker tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Do not migrate whole service trees in this packet; only standards/enforcement/fixtures.
Do not change CLI manifest generation, provider conductor, or Wire composition.
Keep the lease limited to architecture text and pkg-structure checker paths.

payload.title: FND-03: Make cross-owner import enforcement owner-derived
payload.requestedOutcome: Make cross-owner import enforcement owner-derived from the committed service tree so peer root-contract imports pass and peer implementation/subservice imports fail.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Peer root imports pass ownership checker fixtures.
Peer implementation and nested-subservice imports fail ownership checker fixtures.
Enforcement derives from owner inventory rather than a hand-maintained ad hoc allowlist where the plan requires owner-derived rules.
Typecheck/lint and focused ownership-checker tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Do not relocate service packages in this packet.
Do not change public API/CLI/MCP contracts solely to satisfy the checker.

payload.title: FND-10: Create changed-path lease and packet-state manifest
payload.requestedOutcome: Create the changed-path lease and packet-state manifest used by the Packaged Service Structure scheduler so duplicate active leases are rejected before dispatch and every packet has an explicit exclusive path set.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Duplicate active leases are rejected before dispatch.
Every cataloged packet can declare an exclusive changed-path lease and current state.
The manifest is usable by planners without editing generated OpenAPI/CLI/provider surfaces.
Typecheck/lint and focused lease-manifest validation pass.
scopeBoundaries: Program metadata only; do not migrate services.
Do not own shared Wire/HTTP/CLI/MCP fan-in cutovers.
Do not invent a second architecture tree.

The inventory explicitly maps PSS-I02, PSS-I03, and PSS-I04 to those surfaces.
Current live portfolio contention with Schema CLI docs/models/mcp and Standardized Providers conductor is documented as hold conditions, not bypassed.
